tools.name: trustify_advisory_details
tools.description: Get the details of a advisory from a trustify instance by advisory URI

tools.name: trustify_vulnerabilities_for_multiple_purls
tools.description: Get a list of vulnerabilities from a trustify instance affecting the array of PURLs provided in input

purls.description:
Array of PURLs to be investigated for vulnerabilities.
        The array must be delimited by square brackets [] and it must contain strings delimited by double quotes".
        For example: ["pkg:maven/org.jenkins-ci.main/jenkins-core@2.145", "pkg:pypi/tensorflow-gpu@2.6.5"]

tools.description: Get the details of a SBOM from a trustify instance by SBOM URI

tools.name: trustify_sboms_list
tools.description: Get a list of sboms from a trustify instance

limit.description: Maximum number of sboms to return

tools.name: trustify_vulnerability_details
tools.description: Get the details of a vulnerability from a trustify instance by CVE ID

tools.name: trustify_sbom_list_advisories

tools.name: trustify_sbom_list_packages

tools.name: trustify_info
tools.description: Call the info endpoint for a trustify instance

tools.name: trustify_vulnerabilities_list
tools.description: Get a list of vulnerabilities from a trustify instance filtering them by severity and publication date and sorted by publish date

limit.description: Maximum number of vulnerabilities to return, default 1000

published_after.description: Date after which the vulnerability has to be published, provided in the format 2025-04-20T22:00:00.000Z

published_before.description: Date before which the vulnerability has to be published, provided in the format 2025-04-20T22:00:00.000Z

sort_field.description: Field used to sort the vulnerabilities in the output, e.g. 'published'

sort_direction.description: Sort direction, values allowed are only 'desc' and 'asc', default is 'desc'

tools.name: trustify_purl_vulnerabilities
tools.description: Provide a package url-encoded PURL to get the list of vulnerabilities affecting if from a trustify instance

package_uri_or_purl.description: Package URI or package PURL. Values must be url-encoded

tools.name: trustify_advisories_list
tools.description: Get a list of advisories from a trustify instance filtering them by severity and publication date and sorted by publish date

limit.description: Maximum number of advisories to return, default 1000

sort.description:
Query for advisories defined using the following EBNF grammar (ISO/IEC 14977):
                (* Query Grammar - EBNF Compliant *)
                sort = field [ ':', order ] { ',' sort }
                order = ( "asc" | "desc" )
                field = "id" | "modified" | "title" ;
                (* Examples:
                    - Simple sorting: published:desc
                *)
